reviewContext.userProblem: ~/.riela grew to 7.8G (6.0G runtime-message-log.sqlite with auto_vacuum=0, 1.2G sessions-telescreen store, 534M logs, ~1300 execution-lock files). riela gc never removes runtime sessions or logs, and session prune needs explicit roots and workflow ids, never runs automatically, and reclaims space with a full VACUUM that needs about the DB size in free disk. The user wants automatic limit-based deletion of results, messages and logs, plus a keep-forever setting.
requiredOutcomes: One `retention` policy in ~/.riela/config.json (project override, RIELA_RETENTION / RIELA_RETENTION_AUTOMATIC env) with results/messages/logs categories (keepForever, maxAgeDays, maxTotalBytes with human sizes, results.keepWorkflowIds) replaces gc.retentionDays with no alias; a removed key gives an exact error.

Automatic, throttled, single-flight passes (per-target automatic.lock + last-run.json) after workflow run/resume/rerun/continue, inside events serve and serve, and at RielaApp startup plus periodically; failures only warn and never change exit code or stdout.
Only fully terminal, unprotected lineage families are pruned, after lock + in-transaction recheck + tombstones; cap pressure never overrides protection; oldest first; capAchieved reported.
Messages are independent of results: messages-only pruning with message tombstones and triggers, a messagesRetired admission rejection for resume/continue/rerun, and orphan-message pruning.
Log pruning covers only regular files directly in <root>/logs, with lstat, no symlinks, a 24h grace window and a pre-unlink re-lstat.

Reclamation without a full VACUUM on automatic runs: incremental_vacuum + PASSIVE checkpoint, a one-time INCREMENTAL conversion gated on free space (automatic mode capped at 64 MiB), honest reclaimedBytes.
Orphan execution-lock removal with SessionExecutionLock inode hardening.
riela gc becomes the manual front door (--scope, --dry-run, per-category overrides, text/json report, exit codes 0/1/2); session prune stays as the low-level command and uses the new reclaimer.
Docs: README retention section with the keep-forever example, docs/terminal-retention.md, CLI help, riela-workflow-run skill.
nonGoals: No GraphQL, SDL, SurfaceCatalog or web change (gc.sweep already excluded via localToolDefaults).
No discovery of alternate stores beyond user, project and explicit (--session-store / RIELA_SESSION_STORE).
No artifact-root cleanup in automatic passes or riela gc (stays in session prune).
No riela-troubleshooting skill edit (lives in the riela-packages registry).
No back-compat alias for gc.retentionDays / RIELA_GC_RETENTION_DAYS / --retention-days.
constraints: Work only in worktree tmp/automatic-retention-worktree on feat/automatic-retention; workers never stage, commit, stash, reset or push; serial finalization commits locally.
Disjoint writePaths per plan; sharedPaths edited only per sharedPathNotes; per-file sha256 pre/post hash drift protocol.
Focused `swift test --filter` runs from an arm64 shell; no full-suite baseline or per-plan full-suite gate.
Verification records carry integer exitStatus, testsRun and failureCount, with complete logs under tmp/automatic-retention/<planId>/.
Tests use realpath-resolved roots under <cwd>/tmp, fake clocks and injected free space; never the real ~/.riela or /var/folders.
Deletion is deterministic and fails closed; residual-risk and note text never starts with a severity word.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Reuse TerminalRetentionPlan/Executor semantics (lineage families, locks, recheck, tombstones) so automatic retention is no weaker than session prune.
Unknown keys inside retention are errors, so a typo cannot silently disable a limit; absent config means no deletion.
Messages-only pruning writes payload-free session_message_retention_tombstones and blocks re-creation and resume, so retired sessions fail closed instead of resuming with missing history.
allowMessagesRetired lets results pruning proceed on message-retired families without mapping them to executionLocked.
TerminalRetentionPlan exposes `eligible` so messages-only cap selection can include orphan bytes and its recheck stays consistent.
Incremental vacuum + PASSIVE checkpoint avoids 2x disk and never truncates another writer's WAL; a large DB converts once on an operator-run riela gc.
The post-run hook sits in RielaCLIMain.run after output and before exit, so exit code and stdout contracts are untouched.
intentionalTradeoffs: Until a large DB is converted to INCREMENTAL, freed pages are only reused, so the file stops growing but does not shrink on automatic passes.
A fixed 24h log grace window means byte caps can stay unmet (capAchieved=false).
keepWorkflowIds applies to results only; messages of kept workflows follow the messages policy.
Per-pass work bounds (500 families, 1000 log unlinks, 2000 lock unlinks, 65536 vacuum pages) defer the remaining work to later passes.
When messages are notConfigured, results pruning deletes the family's message rows, which matches today's behavior.
supportedEdgeCases: No config, keepForever per category while another category is pruned, and CLI overrides on keepForever as usage errors.
Running, suspended, created, locked and ambiguous-lineage families protected under cap pressure.
Throttle stamp in the future treated as stale; busy lock skip; concurrent processes single-flight.
Message-retired families re-selected neither by messages nor blocked for results; results-tombstoned sessions still fail closed.
Log symlinks, hidden or non-regular entries, files changed between plan and unlink.
Orphan locks busy or re-created after inode swap; pendingRootsMismatch protects a family instead of aborting the pass.
SQLITE_BUSY during reclamation is a warning; insufficient free space defers conversion.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Automatic discovery of stores like ~/.riela/sessions-telescreen without RIELA_SESSION_STORE or --session-store.
Shrinking a large NONE-mode DB during automatic passes.
Crash consistency beyond the existing tombstone/pending-cleanup recovery.
